name: checkbox-tree
title: Checkbox Tree
description: A tree of category labels, each with a small square box, nested under thin indent rules. Ticking a parent selects everything beneath it, and a parent with only some children ticked shows a dash.
use: Users pick categories across a hierarchy, and ticking a parent should select everything below it.
avoid: The source calls itself a demo with no keyboard or tree semantics, so it is not production ready.
a11y: Each box is labelled and can be toggled by keyboard, but the tree has no tree role, so nesting is announced as a flat run of boxes. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow dark list of light grey labels, each led by a small square box and stepped inward from its parent along a faint vertical rule. Ticked boxes are filled white with a dark mark; partly selected branches show a short dash.
behaves: Clicking a box ticks it and every child under it, and clicking a full branch clears them all. A branch whose children are only partly ticked switches its own box to a dash. Nothing animates.
customise: Hand it a tree of nodes plus a renderNode function that draws each row; the parent-child checking logic is internal and all visual styling is left to you.
weight: light: A handful of nested rows and recursive state checks; no animation, timers or canvas.
